title: FreeRTOS: when to use tasks, queues, and loop

spans.text: An RTOS schedules tasks with separate stacks and priorities to meet timing needs. Keep simple sequential work in
. Add a task for independent timing or blocking work, and use a queue to transfer data between tasks. ESP32 Arduino core already uses FreeRTOS.

spans.caption: FreeRTOS: when to use tasks, queues, and loop

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Do not concurrently access shared data without synchronization or call blocking APIs in an ISR. Check stack size, `xTaskCreate` results, priorities, and watchdog behavior; not every sensor needs a task.
